body.description:
Partial update of a brand's voice fields.

Closed allowlist: ``description``, ``tone``, ``phrases_to_avoid``,
``donts``, ``dos``, ``mission_statement``. Unknown keys return **422**.

Omitted keys are left unchanged. ``description`` and ``mission_statement``
accept ``null`` to clear. ``tone`` and the arrays reject ``null`` (**422**);
send ``[]`` to clear an array. Does not regenerate an AI voice directive.
